_comment: Observed Gen 3 base-stat-total bands. Aggregate statistics only - no species names, IDs or game-data references. Outer keys under stage-count buckets are 0-based stage indexes. Derived offline; regenerating requires excluding the dummy record and the unused placeholder slots, which the high-band count of 21 (legendary + mythical + box_legendary) verifies. box_legendary is recorded for completeness only - no tier targets it, since a fifth tier was declined during the #59 interview.
_method: median is the plain median; p10/p90 are nearest-rank percentiles (numpy method='nearest'). All nine non-pseudo buckets below were reproduced exactly from the source data under that rule, which is what pins the method - an interpolating percentile reproduces only 4 of the 9.
_pseudo_comment: The pseudo bucket is a hand-picked subset of the 3-stage bucket, not a disjoint population: every one of its 4 lines is also counted in "3" above. n=4 is the entire observed population, so p10/p90 describe a floor and a ceiling rather than a distribution - the only spread anywhere in it is one middle stage that sits 10 below the other three.
